rationale: Price is trading well below both VWAP ($246.87) and the 9-EMA ($246.47), sitting at only 36.8% of today's range after a sharp drop in the last candle from $246.19 to $244.43 — suggesting selling pressure, but the wide bid-ask spread (52.9 bps) and the stock's position far below VWAP make a clean directional entry risky. The earnings beat catalyst already gapped the stock up ~2% and the subsequent fade below VWAP argues against a long, while the broader market weakness (SPY -1.38%, VIXY +6.73%) adds uncertainty; with limited remaining loss budget ($995) and two open short positions already committed, the risk/reward does not justify adding exposure here.
